Srv\_RampSwitch

Srv\_RampSwitch

This function ramps a signal between two target values, based on a switch value.  
When switch is "TRUE(1)", the function ramps the signal from target B to target A.  
When switch is "FALSE(0)",the function ramps the signal from target A to target B.

The current state value and the target value will be selected by the functionality, only if there is a transition of switch  
  
If the ramp has reached  destination and no change of switch occurs, the output value of SrvX\_RampSwitch follows the target vaue

Example Implementation:

Methods:

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| active | This method is used to determine if the ramp is ramping |
| out | Calculates the ramp value and returns the result on the outport. |
| init | This method is used to set the switch (Determines which of the 2 targets shall be used) |
| pos | Input Value for a bit of the memory element 'Flag' |

Parameter:

| Parameter | Description | Implementation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dir | Direction of ramp | sint16 OneToOne same memory location as set in Settings->Memory Location of Instance |
| Dt | Time between two calculation calls  Attention: Dt element and Dt port must have the same conversion formula.  Hint:  If using Per\_Dur as implementation for Dt element in BDE, simulation does not work for time dependent elements. Therefore it is recommended to use Time\_Dt. | sint32 Time\_Dt |
| Param | Parameter structure for ramp slopes | SrvRampParam  sint32 int = 2^16 / 1000 \* fact\_in \* phys |
| Flag | State information of the ramp | uint8 OneToOne |
| Return/active | Returns whether ramp is ramping or not | Uint8 |
| Return/out | Returns the actual state of the ramp | sint32 OneToOne |
| Return/pos | return the memory element | uint8 |
| State | Pointer to actual value of the ramp | sint32 iconv\_x |
| Swtch | Parameter for switching between Target "A" and Target "B" | Uint8 |
| FlagTmp | Stores the switch position | Sint32 OneToOne |
| Xa | Target value for the ramp to reach if switch is in position "A" | Sint32 conv\_x |
| Xb | Target value for the ramp to reach if switch is in position "B" | Sint32 conv\_x |
